findings.evidence: A bounded search is sufficient for one factual question or a small number of claims with clear authoritative sources.
findings.fix: Before the first call, ask: is the gap one missing public fact (Search at 3/512), a sourced explanation (Ask), or several independent questions (split)? State the answer in one line, then follow the matching bullet.

findings.evidence: - Snippets can be stale: open the cited page before attributing a claim to it.
findings.fix: Add the condition the eval already uses: when the cited page cannot be opened, qualify the claim as the snippet's statement at its date and say the page was not inspected; never cite it as current support.

findings.evidence: Route external web research to Perplexity MCP: perplexity_search for current facts and links
findings.fix: Route external web research to Perplexity MCP: perplexity_search for current facts, links and recent tutorials (default max_results 3, max_tokens_per_page 512), perplexity_ask for sourced synthesis. Use for general web information, recent news, comparisons, tutorials, or a current-information question even when the user never says search. Not for library/framework docs (Context7), Graphite gt CLI help (Graphite MCP), this workspace (Nx MCP), one supplied URL (URL Crawler), repository-local lookup, or mcp__perplexity__perplexity_research (use a configured /research agent).

findings.evidence: Read README.md only when you need the call-shape examples; do not load it for a single routing decision.
findings.fix: Move the two TypeScript call shapes into references/call-shapes.md and say: read references/call-shapes.md when you are about to call perplexity_search or perplexity_ask; do not load it, or README.md, for a single routing decision. Keep README.md for the repository.

findings.evidence: If it is unavailable, use an available appropriate tool, say which substitution was made, and report the limitation if no suitable tool exists.
findings.fix: Name the substitute per row: library docs with no Context7, say so and do not use Perplexity; gt help with no Graphite MCP, use the local gt CLI; one URL with no URL Crawler, fetch that URL; only a missing Perplexity tool falls through to the other Perplexity tool, then WebSearch.

findings.evidence: The only trigger for raising Search limits to 5 results / 1024 tokens is an empty or inadequate first result set.
findings.fix: Define inadequate in one line: fewer than two dated, on-topic sources, or none that states the asked fact. Do not raise limits because a source disagrees or the user asked for coverage; those follow the later bullets.
